entities.name: Dars Gostok
entities.description: A Boros Firefist captain who fought alongside Gideon Jura against the Gruul and Rakdos.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker and Boros commander who leads the Ninth District battle.

entities.name: Anza
entities.description: Boros soldier who helped Gideon lure the Gruul clansmen.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: Boros officer who drew the Rakdos horde into the square.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose Firefist soldiers fought in the battle.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Guild whose horde and defilers were drawn into the square.

entities.name: Battle of the Ninth District
entities.description: Boros battle to make Gruul and Rakdos forces destroy each other.

entities.name: Ninth District
entities.description: Ravnican district where the battle occurred.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: Goblin leader in a later gang war.

entities.name: Shattergang Brothers
entities.description: Goblins in a gang war with Krenko.

events.summary: The Boros plan to lure Gruul and Rakdos forces together so they kill each other; Gideon and Anza lure the Gruul while Tajic lures the Rakdos.
events.quote: the Boros tried to lure Gruul and Rakdos forces together in order to make them kill each other

events.summary: Dars assembles the Firefist hidden in the square on Gideon's orders and waits.
events.quote: On Gideon's orders, Dars had assembled the Firefist in the square, hidden in the surrounding buildings.

events.summary: Dars's firecasters blast the arriving Gruul from windows and doorways.
events.quote: he had his secret firecasters blast the Gruul from windows and doorways

events.summary: Tajic enters the square chased by Rakdos defilers.
events.quote: Tajic entered the square with a yell, chased by a swarm of Rakdos defilers.

events.summary: The Firefist disengages and forms a wall as the Rakdos pour in and tear into the Gruul.
events.quote: Dars ordered a knight to sound the trumpet

events.summary: Rakdos and Gruul slaughter each other while the Boros close in, a success.
events.quote: Rakdos and Gruul slaughtered each other in the center of the square

events.summary: Dars later rescues Gideon and trapped hostages during a goblin gang war.
events.quote: coming to the rescue of Gideon Jura and some trapped hostages

relations.quote: Dars Gostok is a Boros Firefist captain
who fought with Gideon Jura against the Gruul and the Rakdos
